[spoiler=[b]The New Republic[/b]]

Negotiations between the inner circle and Müller dragged on throughout the day. 

Eventually, after several hours of back and forth, the terms would be set for the surrender of the Kaiser. 

In exchange for the dissolution of the imperial government and the abdication of the Kaiser several reassurances would be granted. 

Among them the Kaiser and his family would be granted full legal immunity, control over his dynastic wealth and a position as a Councilor-for-life. 

On September 7th, the Neue Republik was declared. 

Through a live broadcast, High Councilor Vogt would relay the following speech at 1800 hours on several major media outlets. 

My fellow citizens, 

The Third Hochdeutsche Empire is hereby dissolved. Sovereignty shall return to the people. 

The New Republic is proclaimed, the second in our history, built on the values of liberty, justice and democracy. 

No ruler shall stand above the people in the Republic. No law shall bind the liberty of our people. No voice shall be silenced for speaking the truth. 

The strength of the Neue Republik shall not be measured in the power of its armies or the heritage of its aristocracy. 

It shall be measured in the freedom of its people, the dignity it gives to its citizens, the fairness of its laws and a commitment to national prosperity.

Let the world know that the people are free and shall govern themselves. 

Long live the Republik, long live the Hochdeutsche people.[/spoiler]
